name: @mercatus-liber/advertising
description: Admin-curated advertising campaigns/creatives filling CMS's ad-slot component with real content, plus stateless weighted-random rotation among currently-eligible creatives (subsystem 19). Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only -- never imports @mercatus-liber/cms, @mercatus-liber/service-areas, @mercatus-liber/catalog, @mercatus-liber/marketing-catalog, @mercatus-liber/cart, @mercatus-liber/checkout-orders, @mercatus-liber/promotions, @mercatus-liber/bundles, @mercatus-liber/recommendations, @mercatus-liber/inventory, or @mercatus-liber/analytics. Targeting fields (serviceAreaId, pageSlug) are bare strings never validated against any other subsystem here, matching recommendations' deliberately thin posture.
